durable_enqueue.detail: Enqueue process exited; a separate worker completed the persisted task

conflicting_key.detail: Same idempotency key with different payload rejected

duplicate_delivery.detail: Duplicates before and after completion produced one job and one business effect

transient_retry.detail: Two transient failures followed by success; exactly three attempts and one effect

permanent_failure.detail: Permanent error dead-lettered immediately without a business effect

retry_exhaustion.detail: Transient failure stopped at the configured three-attempt budget

concurrent_workers.detail: Two worker processes completed six jobs once each

lease_fencing.detail: Expired owner rejected after reclaim; only the new token committed

crash_rolls_back_effect.detail: Process exit between effect and ack rolled back the business write

expired_claim_recovers.detail: A crashed claim owner was recovered after lease expiry, without dropping the job

graceful_shutdown.detail: SIGTERM finished current work and left the next task pending

cleanup.detail: Workers reaped and temporary SQLite databases/journals removed
